text:
maria: Heads-up — after the overnight BMC firmware rollout to the oob-bridge pool in us-west, ~30 nodes are failing PXE boot. Observed a secure-boot bit flip to enabled on those machines. Anyone seeing this?

josh: I saw a couple of alerts earlier, assumed noise. Can you paste the node list?

maria: node IDs: rack7-02..rack7-12, rack9-01, rack9-03, plus a few sparse ones. Infra bot shows the job finished at 03:12.

infra-bot: firmware-rollout job 2026-11-03T03:12:07Z completed for image bmc-3.4.1-signed. Success: 3,212 hosts. Partial failures reported: 31 hosts.

samir: quick hypothesis: signed image contained an optional secureboot toggle field that defaults to "on" when the bridge's profile is older. We saw mismatch in the manifest parsing on older BMCs before.

elaine: Can someone run `ipmitool mc info` and `ipmitool chassis bootparam get 5` on one of the affected nodes? I can SSH into rack7-04 now.

maria: ran on rack7-04 — `ipmitool mc info` shows firmware bmc-3.4.1, vendor: aspeed, signature-verify: OK. `chassis bootparam get 5` returns Boot Flag: 0x40 (SecureBoot enabled).

josh: uh. That flag shouldn't be modified by this image. We added a guard in the upload step. Possible regression in the signing tool that added an extra toggle.

samir: I pulled the signed blob and compared with prior version: the new manifest includes `secure_boot: true` under the `oob-defaults` stanza for older models. Previous manifest had no explicit secure_boot key. When the bridge firmware parses an unknown key it used to ignore; new parser sets explicit flag.

maria: Actionable — rolling back the manifest on affected hosts and pushing a no-op patch to clear the flag. Can we do a targeted rollback rather than full image rollback?

elaine: Yes — we can push a BMC command to clear secure boot bit remotely using ipmi for these chips: `ipmitool raw 0x30 0x45 0x01 0x00` (example). I'll script it and run on a single node for canary.

oncall-bot: Incident created: OOB-BMC-SB-FLIP-1791234567. Priority: P2. Assigned: eng-infra oncall.

josh: Try the script on rack7-04 first, then 7-05, then a few in rack9. If it clears and PXE resumes, scale the fix. If not, roll back to bmc-3.4.0 image for the affected nodes.

maria: Canary executed on rack7-04 at 04:05Z. Command returned OK and `chassis bootparam get 5` now shows Boot Flag: 0x00. Rack7-04 proceeded with PXE successfully.

samir: Good. I'll generate a short playbook to target the 31 nodes and add a guard to the manifest signing tool to drop `secure_boot` when not explicitly set by the customer.

elaine: Noted — also open a ticket with the vendor about parser behavior on legacy BMC versions. We should flag as a breaking change and ask for a hotfix.

josh: TL;DR — cause: manifest introduced `secure_boot:true` for older models, BMC parser applied it. Remediation: remote clear + sign-tool guard + vendor follow-up. Rolling fix across affected nodes now (ETA 30m).

maria: I'll post a short incident summary to #incidents and ping support for any customer impact. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: mass-bmc-fix job started at 04:35Z targeting 31 hosts. Progress: 0/31.

oncall-bot: Update scheduled: 04:55Z — follow-up notes will be posted then.
